metadata.title: Africa Is 14× Bigger Than Greenland 🌍 #shorts
metadata.description:
On most world maps Greenland looks as big as Africa. It isn't even close: Africa is about 14 times bigger. The Mercator projection stretches land near the poles, so Greenland, Canada and Russia look huge while Africa looks small.

The mainland United States, China, India and much of Western Europe would all fit inside Africa.

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain). Areas computed from the data.

#maps #geography #truesize #mercator #shorts
